description: This file declares a template-based interface for gradient checking in TensorFlow's C++ framework. It primarily contains function templates for computing the maximum element-wise gradient error between analytically computed and numerically approximated Jacobians, facilitating debugging and verification of gradient computations.

methods.name: ComputeGradientError
methods.description: Computes the maximum error between the Jacobian matrices of input tensors 'xs' and 'ys' using the provided scope. It compares the analytical Jacobian with a numerical approximation to verify correctness of gradients.

methods.name: ComputeGradientError (overload)
methods.description: Computes the maximum gradient error for a specific input tensor 'x' with an initial value, comparing the associated Jacobians with respect to output 'y'.
